result.instructions: Tools for Growave, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which VIP tier is this customer in, and how far are they from the next one?"; "Show the reviews with the lowest ratings for our top product this month."; "Which earning rules give the most points for a purchase right now?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Growave data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run growave_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run growave_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run growave_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. growave_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: growave_get_program_status
tools.title: Get loyalty program status
tools.description: Show which Growave programs are enabled for the shop: points, referrals and VIP tiers. Good first call. Growave API: GET /v2/rewards/getLoyaltyProgramStatus.

tools.name: growave_list_tiers
tools.title: List VIP tiers
tools.description: List the VIP tiers of the shop with the conditions and benefits of each tier. Growave API: GET /v2/rewards/getTiers.

locale.description: Locale for translated text, for example en (default en).

tools.name: growave_get_tier_progress
tools.title: Get customer tier progress
tools.description: Show one customer's current VIP tier and progress toward the next tier. Growave API: GET /v2/rewards/getTierProgress.

customerIdentifier.description: Shopify customer ID, email address or phone number (for example test@mail.com or +14155550100).

locale.description: Locale for translated text, for example en (default en).

tools.name: growave_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one customer's Growave profile and loyalty details, looked up by Shopify customer ID, email or phone. Growave API: GET /v2/customers/getCustomer.

customerIdentifier.description: Shopify customer ID, email address or phone number (for example test@mail.com or +14155550100).

tools.name: growave_get_active_rewards
tools.title: Get customer active rewards
tools.description: List the rewards a customer can use now (discounts, free products, gift cards and similar). Growave API: GET /v2/rewards/getCustomerActiveRewards.

customerIdentifier.description: Shopify customer ID, email address or phone number (for example test@mail.com or +14155550100).

locale.description: Locale for translated text, for example en (default en).

tools.name: growave_get_activity_history
tools.title: Get customer activity history
tools.description: List a customer's points and reward activity, newest first, with optional paging and an order filter. Growave API: GET /v2/rewards/getActivityHistory.

customerIdentifier.description: Shopify customer ID, email address or phone number (for example test@mail.com or +14155550100).

orderId.description: Only activity linked to this Shopify order ID.

locale.description: Locale for translated text, for example en (default en).

tools.name: growave_get_punch_card_progress
tools.title: Get customer punch card progress
tools.description: Show one customer's punch card progress. Growave API: GET /v2/rewards/getPunchCardProgress.

customerIdentifier.description: Shopify customer ID, email address or phone number (for example test@mail.com or +14155550100).

tools.name: growave_list_earning_rules
tools.title: List earning rules
tools.description: List the actions that earn points or rewards (purchases, reviews, sign-ups, social follows and so on), per locale. Growave API: GET /v2/rewards/getEarningRules.

customerIdentifier.description: Shopify customer ID, email address or phone number. Leave empty for shop-wide results.

locale.description: Locale for translated text, for example en (default en).

tools.name: growave_list_spending_rules
tools.title: List spending rules
tools.description: List the rewards that customers can redeem (discounts, free shipping, free products, gift cards), per locale. Growave API: GET /v2/rewards/getSpendingRules.

customerIdentifier.description: Shopify customer ID, email address or phone number. Leave empty for shop-wide results.

locale.description: Locale for translated text, for example en (default en).

tools.name: growave_list_referral_sessions
tools.title: List referral sessions
tools.description: List referral sessions with optional filters by referrer, referred customer, order or status. Growave API: GET /v2/rewards/getReferralSessions.

referrerIdentifier.description: Referrer's Shopify customer ID, email or phone.

referredIdentifier.description: Referred customer's Shopify customer ID, email or phone.

orderId.description: Only sessions linked to this Shopify order ID.

tools.name: growave_list_reviews
tools.title: List reviews
tools.description: List product and shop reviews with filters for product, rating, text, photos, publication state and sort order. Growave API: GET /v2/reviews/getReviews.

customerIdentifier.description: Shopify customer ID, email address or phone number. Leave empty for shop-wide results.

productId.description: Only reviews of this Shopify product ID.

rate.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1-5).

search.description: Text to search in review titles and bodies.

tools.name: growave_get_review_aggregates
tools.title: Get review aggregates
tools.description: Get the average rating and review count of one product, with an optional star breakdown, photo count and reply count. Growave API: GET /v2/reviews/getReviewAggregates.

withStarsDistribution.description: Include the count of reviews per star.

withMediaCount.description: Include the number of reviews with photos or videos.

withReplyCount.description: Include the number of shop replies.

tools.name: growave_can_create_review
tools.title: Check if a customer can review
tools.description: Check whether a customer may leave a review for a product. Use it before drafting a review request. Growave API: GET /v2/reviews/canCreateReview.

customerIdentifier.description: Shopify customer ID, email address or phone number (for example test@mail.com or +14155550100).

annotations.title: Check if a customer can review

tools.name: growave_list_questions
tools.title: List product questions
tools.description: List customer questions about products, with filters for product, publication state and sort order. Growave API: GET /v2/questions/getQuestions.

customerIdentifier.description: Shopify customer ID, email address or phone number. Leave empty for shop-wide results.

productId.description: Only questions about this Shopify product ID.

tools.name: growave_list_wishlists
tools.title: List wishlists
tools.description: List the wishlists of a customer, or of a shopper session. Growave API: GET /v2/wishlists/getWishlists.

customerIdentifier.description: Shopify customer ID, email address or phone number. Leave empty for shop-wide results.

sessionToken.description: Wishlist session token of a shopper who is not logged in.

tools.title: Get wishlist items
tools.description: List the products in one wishlist, with paging. Pass the wishlist ID from growave_list_wishlists. Growave API: GET /v2/wishlists/getWishlistItems.

customerIdentifier.description: Shopify customer ID, email address or phone number. Leave empty for shop-wide results.

sessionToken.description: Wishlist session token of a shopper who is not logged in.
